lines.text: The LORD tells David's Lord to sit at His right hand until He makes His enemies a footstool.
The LORD extends the mighty scepter of David's Lord from Sinai and says to rule in the midst of His enemies.
On His day of battle, the people of David's Lord shall be willing, arrayed in holy splendor.
The LORD swears and will not change His mind: David's Lord is a priest forever in the order of Aaron.
In the day of His wrath He will crush kings, judge the nations, and drink from the brook by the road.
